name: SHE_kanskigor
summary: This EA opens a daily trade at a specified time based on the previous day's candlestick direction. If the previous daily candle closed bullish (open < close), it buys; if bearish (open > close), it sells. Positions include optional stop loss and take profit, and the EA only trades once per day within a 5-minute time window.
summary_zh: 该EA根据前一日K线方向在指定时间开仓：前一日日线收阳则买入，收阴则卖出。每笔交易设有可选止损和止盈，每天仅在5分钟时间窗口内交易一次。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于前一日日线K线的方向延续，即如果昨日日线收阳（开盘价低于收盘价），则今日做多；若昨日日线收阴（开盘价高于收盘价），则今日做空。入场条件为当前时间在指定的StartTime之后的5分钟窗口内，且当前没有持仓。出场条件依赖于用户设定的止损和止盈点数，若无设定则无退出机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，由Lots参数控制，无加仓减仓逻辑。资金管理方面完全缺失，无风险比例计算、无账户余额检查、无最大亏损限制。该策略本质上是一个简单的日线动量延续策略，逻辑非常朴素，缺乏过滤条件和多因子确认。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the directional continuation of the previous daily candlestick. If the prior day's daily candle is bullish (open below close), the EA buys; if bearish (open above close), it sells. Entry conditions require the current time to fall within a 5-minute window after the configured StartTime and no existing position on the symbol. Exit conditions rely solely on user-configured stop loss and take profit in points, with no trailing stop or dynamic exit mechanism. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size controlled by the Lots parameter, with no scaling, martingale, or equity-based adjustment. Money management is entirely absent—there is no risk percentage calculation, no account balance check, and no maximum drawdown limit. The strategy is essentially a naive daily momentum continuation system lacking any filter conditions or multi-factor confirmation.

parameters.name: Lots
parameters.description_en: Fixed lot size; 0 uses risk percentage

parameters.name: Profit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points; 0 disables TP

parameters.name: Stop
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points; 0 disables SL

parameters.name: Symb
parameters.description: 交易品种，*表示使用当前图表品种
parameters.description_en: Trading symbol; * uses current chart symbol

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和维护
使用MQL5标准交易库（CTrade、CSymbolInfo），代码规范性好
设有交易时间窗口限制，避免重复开仓
检查是否已有持仓，防止同方向重复入场
止损止盈参数可配置，给予用户灵活控制
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and maintain
Uses MQL5 standard trade libraries (CTrade, CSymbolInfo) for proper code structure
Trading time window prevents repeated entries within the same day
Checks for existing positions to avoid duplicate entries in the same direction
Configurable stop loss and take profit parameters provide user flexibility
cons: 策略过于简单，仅依赖单根日线K线方向，缺乏过滤和确认机制
无资金管理逻辑，固定手数不随账户规模调整，风险不可控
5分钟时间窗口过窄，可能因流动性不足或报价延迟导致无法成交
止损止盈设为0时完全无保护，可能导致巨额亏损
无点差过滤，在点差较大时开仓可能导致不利入场价格
trade标志在跨日时无重置逻辑，可能导致某些交易日永远无法交易
cons_en: Strategy is overly simplistic, relying on a single daily candle direction without filters or confirmation
No money management logic—fixed lot size doesn't adapt to account size, making risk uncontrolled
5-minute time window is very narrow and may miss execution due to low liquidity or quote delays
Setting Stop or Profit to 0 removes all protection, potentially leading to catastrophic losses
No spread filter—opening positions during high spread conditions results in unfavorable entry prices
The 'trade' flag has no daily reset logic, potentially causing certain trading days to be permanently skipped
improvements: 增加多因子过滤条件，如均线方向、ATR波动率过滤、周线趋势确认等，提高信号质量
实现基于账户风险比例的动态仓位计算，替代固定手数
添加点差过滤和新的日线Bar检测逻辑，确保交易环境良好且不重复交易
修复trade标志的每日重置逻辑，避免状态错误导致错过交易日
improvements_en: Add multi-factor filters such as moving average direction, ATR volatility filter, and weekly trend confirmation to improve signal quality
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account risk percentage instead of fixed lots
Add spread filtering and proper new daily bar detection to ensure favorable trading conditions and prevent duplicate trades
Fix the 'trade' flag daily reset logic to avoid state errors that cause missed trading days

risk_points: 止损和止盈参数可设为0，此时交易无任何保护，风险极高
固定手数无资金管理，小账户可能过度杠杆
trade布尔标志缺乏每日重置机制，可能造成状态锁定
5分钟窗口在高波动或低流动性时可能以较差价格成交
无点差检查，大点差环境下入场成本过高
risk_points_en: Stop loss and take profit can be set to 0, leaving trades completely unprotected with extreme risk
Fixed lot sizing without money management may cause over-leveraging on small accounts
The 'trade' boolean flag lacks a daily reset mechanism, potentially causing state lockup
The 5-minute window may result in poor fills during high volatility or low liquidity
No spread check means entry costs can be excessively high during wide spread conditions
